page.lede: A short, curated set of links that place this work in its broader context, enough to understand where it sits without drowning out Alberta's own contribution.

items.title: Ministry of Technology and Innovation
items.desc: The Government of Alberta ministry behind this collection, leading the province's technology, innovation, AI, data centre, cybersecurity, and digital government agenda.

items.title: AI Usage Policy
items.desc: How the Government of Alberta governs the use of artificial intelligence across the public service, covering security, privacy, ethics, bias, and accountability. (PDF)

items.title: Sovereign Compute Environment (PQR)
items.desc: Alberta Technology and Innovation's pre-qualification request for a sovereign compute environment, inviting suppliers to qualify across sovereign compute, AI solutions, and analytics to support government decision-making.

items.title: AI for All
items.desc: Canada's national AI strategy, anchored in trust, opportunity, and sovereignty, setting out goals to broaden AI adoption across the economy and build sovereign infrastructure.

items.title: Buy Canadian Policy
items.desc: Federal procurement direction that prioritizes Canadian suppliers, content, and trusted trade partners to strengthen Canada's economic resilience.
